PILOT ACHIEVEMENTS

LOCKHEED LANDER

Fly any Lockheed aircraft or pilot a Lamprey underwater drone. Master each flight and discover more aircraft.

C-130
Choose a plane and start your flight.

Click the game to climb, or tap anywhere on a phone while flying. Each click or tap gives one lift. During the final approach, reach the runway marker at a safe height and a gentle vertical speed. A successful landing unlocks one new paint scheme for that aircraft. Land the C-130, F-35, C-5, Black Hawk, F-16, and F-22 once each to unlock the SR-71. Progress is saved in this browser. Unlock the legendary aircraft that started it all, the very first aircraft built by the Lockheed brothers—the 1913 Model G Hydro-Aeroplane!
